items.information: 🇧🇷 O Capixaba Challenge 2023 é o 15º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapixabaChallenge2023/register); - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE) do Rafael Cinoto; - Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição; - Divirta-se! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Capixaba Challenge 2023 is the 15th Official Competition of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapixabaChallenge2023/register) tab; - Arrive at the competition venue 30 minutes before the event in which you will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, the cube may not be accepted for the competition; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE) by Rafael Cinoto; - Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition; - Have a lot of fun! ------------------------------------- ### Organização/Organization: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ1k4IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--05c34cfd81e1c48df3d1c4c00f5fa2977da05bc5/logo-speedcubes%20(1).png)

items.name: Voula Summer Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--25a11a161841639a3cff2ecfb046c27deb82697e/Cubestore_VSO23_post.jpg) Το Voula Summer Open 2023 είναι ο 3oς WCA διαγωνισμός στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Είμαστε περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών "Road to Greek Nationals" εστιάζουμε σε κάθε διαγωνισμό σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε στο ελληνικό κοινό τα αγωνίσματα του One Handed/Λύση με ένα χέρι και του Fewest Move Challenge (FMC)/Δοκιμασία λύσης με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος μας είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα της Ελλάδας προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα WCA events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) The Voula Open 2023 is the third competition this year in Greece. We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! During each "Road to Greek finals" competition, we focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we are aiming to bring the events One Handed and Fewest Move Challenge (FMC) closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all WCA events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! items.information: NZ South Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2023 is the first regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals later in 2023.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Stockholmsligan Final 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till finaltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2023! Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- A warm welcome to final competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2023! More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

venue.address: South Africa, 28 Droste Cres, Droste Park, Johannesburg, 2094

items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce South Africa's 2023 National Championship. Compete against South Africa's fastest speedcubers and break some records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/216560-cubingza-national-championship-2023#/) page. # COMPETING This is an open championship - meaning anyone is free to compete. All WCA events except FMC* will be held, with winners in each event being declared the 2023 South African Champion for that event. # SPECTATORS Competitors are allowed to bring up to 2 guests as spectators. Spectators attend for free. # VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at this video. Parents and spectators are welcome to help out with volunteer tasks as well. # SPONSORS Massive thanks to the following sponsors, without whom this competition would not be happening. BMG, who are generously providing their venue at BMG World for the competition, and making Nationals in Joburg a reality. Speecubes.co.za and CubeCo, South Africa's local cube stores, who will be sponsoring prize money and store vouchers for the competition's winners. InsightEdge (Pty) Ltd. has also generously offered to sponsor further prize money towards the winners and podium finishers. *\\*A separate FMC Championship will be held at a later date. This championship will take place simultaneously in multiple locations (CPT, JHB and DBN) to minimise travel requirements.*

items.name: Aasee Algorithms 2023
items.information: Herzlich willkommen bei der allerersten Competition in Münster in der Geschichte der WCA! Wir laden euch ein zu einem Cubing-Wochenende mit einer bunten Mischung an Events direkt am Aasee. Spannung und Spaß sind garantiert und wir drücken euch die Daumen für viele persönliche Rekorde. Wir freuen uns gleichermaßen über neue und bekannte Gesichter - wenn du Spaß am Cuben hast, bist du hier genau richtig. Bis bald in Münster! Euer Orgateam Welcome to the very first competition in Münster in the history of the WCA! We invite you to a cubing weekend with a colorful mix of events directly at the lake Aasee. Excitement and fun are guaranteed and we keep our fingers crossed for many personal records. We are equally happy to welcome new and familiar faces - if you enjoy cubing, this is the right place for you. See you soon in Münster! Your organization team

items.name: Swedish Championship 2023
items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2023! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2023! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 25 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 24:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 25 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 24:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.name: LSP Hverdagskubing Mai 2023

venue.name: LSP
venue.details: Stort rosa bygg. Inngang fra Østerdalsgata. 1. etg med LSP Beachflagg utenfor.

items.information: Hjertelig velkommen til vår andre hverdagskubing på LSP i Oslo. Kveldens konkurranse har et veldig spesielt opplegg, der hver deltaker har 18 minutter i total løsningstid til å gjennomføre alle sine løsninger. Det er deltageren selv som på forhånd velger hvilke grener man vil delta i og bruke sine 18 minutter på. Konkurransen foregår mandag kveld og varer i tilsammen ca 4 timer og du kan delta i maks 5 grener. Vi holder til i et lite lokale sentralt i Oslo der LSPkuberne pleier å ha kubetreff. Vi håper at både erfarne og nye speedcubere i Oslo har lyst til å prøve seg på konkurranser lokalt. Vi vil lage månedlige konkurranser framover og se hvilket format som funker. Målet er å starte Osloligaen til høsten, der vi kårer en vinner etter resultatene fra flere små konkurranser gjennom høsten og vinteren. Lokalet er har minimalt med tilskuerplass, så det er fint hvis antall gjester er så lavt som mulig. Konkurransen er sponset av NORDICUBE og SLOAP. -------------------- Welcome to the second edition of LSP Hverdagskubing in Oslo. This competitions has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves. The competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, that each competitor can choose a maximum of five (5) events to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a Monday, lasts only approx. 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Hverdagskubing") so you don't miss any important information. We are based in a small venue in the center of Oslo where the LSPcubers tend to have cube meetings. We hope that both experienced and new speedcubers in Oslo want to join these local competitions. We will create monthly competitions in the future and see which format works. The aim is to start the Oslo League in the autumn, where we will choose a winner based on the results of several small competitions throughout the autumn and winter. The venue has limited space for guests. Please bring as few guests as possible. The competition is sponsored by NORDICUBE and SLOAP.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch "Wiener Frühling 2023" als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Dániel Varga und Felix Strasser und wird delegiert von Bence Barát, Emma Beranová und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce "Wiener Frühling 2023" as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Dániel Varga, Felix Strasser and is delegated by Bence Barát, Emma Beranová and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

items.name: National Capital Region B 2023
items.information: ### (EN) ## NCR 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [National Capital Region A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalCapitalRegionA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/en) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ## Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). For new competitors, this video may help with competing. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### (FR) ## Série NCR 2023 Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec [National Capital Region A 2023] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalCapitalRegionA2023). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à *une* de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ## Liste de diffusion Nous sommes conscients de la demande extrêmement élevée de compétitions en Ontario. Nous travaillons dur pour répondre à cette demande et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement des compétitions plus grandes et plus nombreuses. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les médias sociaux et/ou [joindre notre liste de diffusion] (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. Nous vous remercions de votre patience pendant cette période où nous nous efforçons de faire face à la croissance passionnante de la communauté du cube. ## Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ## Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Larissa Spring Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdm8xIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dd65eb480c4a2f6ae601106b518d7da158eeb179/336963227_762958098547893_38350618552278990_n.jpg) Larissa Spring Open 2023 είναι ο δεύτερος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών Road to Greek Nationals, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 3x3x3 blindfolded και του Skewb πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca ΚΑΙ να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου με την κάρτα σας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) Larissa Spring Open 2023 is the second competition this year in Greece. In the next "Road to Greek finals" competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 3x3x3 blindfolded and Skewb closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the second Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will take on a "Big & Weird" theme on Saturday, with bigger NxN cubes and some side events not often held in Cape Town, with a more familiar event structure on Sunday! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/208588-cubingza-cape-cubes-autumn-2023/#/) page. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: Palmerston North 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 22 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 21:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 22 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 21:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.information: ## Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before April 1, 2023 at 7:00 PM EDT. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. items.information: We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Nanaimo, B.C., for the Nanaimo Swing into Spring 2023 cubing competition. Our [last competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NanaimoBacktoSchool2022) was a great success and we are looking forward to seeing you all again. Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed. We look forward to a full house of 110 competitors! Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. For example, if you're only competing in events that are on Saturday, then you don't need to come on Sunday. Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

items.name: Save Ramir Cubing Kazakhstan 2023
items.information: Соревнование проводится с благотворительной целью. Все вырученные средства пойдут в помощь сбору средств на лечение 3-летнего ребенка с инвалидностью Рамира Ковалевского, с диагнозом «Спинальная мышечная атрофия 2 типа», который нуждается в самом дорогостоящем лекарственном препарате в мире, ZOLGENSMA. Главный спонсор соревнования – компания «Леовит». Соревнование проводится при поддержке школы №157 и общественного фонда «Alem Asar».. Смотрите наш аккаунт в Instagram (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers), чтобы узнавать новости и подробную информацию о соревновании! Соревнование будет проходить в спортзале школы №157. Будем рады видеть вас на соревновании! Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында өткізеді. Жарыстан бүкіл түскен қаражат спиналды бұлшық атрофия диагнозына шалдыққан мүгедекке 3 жасар бала Рамир Ковалевскийге әлемде ең бағалы дәрі «ZOLGENSMA» сатып алу үшін қаржы жинауға және көмектесуге бағыттайды Жарыстың бас демеушісі – «Леовит» компаниясы. Жарыс мектептiң №157 мен «Alem Asar» қоғамдық қорының көмегiмен өткiзіледi. Біздің Instagram аккаунтымыздың парақшасында (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) жаңалықтар және жарыс туралы ақпарат көре аласыздар! Жарыс мектептің №157 спорт залында өткізіледі. Сіздің жарысқа белсенді ат салысып қатысқаныңызға қуаныштымыз! The competition is organised for charity. All the proceeds made from the competition will be spent for fundraising for helping 3-years old kid, Ramir Kovalevsky, in his spinal muscular atrophy medical treatment to purchase him the most expensive cure in the world, ZOLGENSMA. The Leovit company is the main sponsor of the competition. The competition is organised with the help of school #157 and Alem Asar social foundation. Watch our posts in our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) to learn the news and more information about the competition! The competition will be set in the sports hall of the school #157. We will be happy to see you at the competition!

items.information: ## Pickering 2023 Series We are running four competitions as part of the Pickering 2023 Series. You will only be able to compete in *one* of these four competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminder You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: ## Waterloo Favourites 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [Waterloo Favourites A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WaterlooFavouritesA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before February 4, 2023 at 7:00 PM EST. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

items.name: Wellington Summer 2023
items.information: Wellington Summer 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2N0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83fc6c836b78e431cd8e0d013efd6be412a6e388/IMG_9500.JPG) Athens Winter Open 2023 είναι ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα , ύστερα από μία πολλά υποσχόμενη χρονιά. Στις επόμενες διοργανώσεις, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 διοργανώσεις που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστές στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 6x6 και του 7x7 πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλες οι εκδηλώσεις θα είναι οικείες στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή για το cubing γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείτε ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca και να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Athens Winter Open 2023 is the first competition this year in Greece, following a very successfull year of competitions. In the next competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 6x6 and 7x7 closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the eca site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.name: Crazy Cubing Centurion 2023
items.information: Kick off the 2023 cubing season in Gauteng with a two day competition in Centurion. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial" to be held at the start of Sunday. If you are a new competitor who is competing in any events on Saturday, please speak to a delegate who will show you how to compete and perform the above duties. We also recommend that you take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSOR [CubeCo](https://cubeco.co.za/) is sponsoring this competition, and will be offering cubes for sale on the day. ### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).** * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. * **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.** --- Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).** * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office. * **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.information: Day 1 Events: 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, Clock, Megaminx, 4x4x4 Blindfolded Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, December 3rd is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, December 13th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

Torneo oficial que se realizará en el Museo Metropolitano de Monterrey, lugar emblemático de la capital regiomontana que tiene más de 100 años de existencia en los que tuvo varias funciones, como ser la sede del gobierno municipal, y siendo actualmente el hogar de resguardo de 300 piezas históricas. Ahora, pasa a ser el sitio oficial para esta competencia que es la segunda parte de la **Ruta Regia**. Official tournament that will take place at the Museo Metropolitano de Monterrey, an emblematic place in the capital of Nuevo Leon that has existed for more than 100 years in which it had many functions, such as being the place of the municipal government, and currently has 300 historical pieces. Now, it becomes the official place for this competition, which is the second part of the **Ruta Regia**. We invite you to be part of this tournament that will be held in the center of the city, which is open to anyone. items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2022 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.name: Buenos Aires Cubea 2022
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajBqIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7beabe32163b26aed8c733e5c7562315ef48ade7/image.png) ¡Bienvenidos al **Buenos Aires Cubea 2022**! Este será un torneo enfocado en reunir competidores de todas partes del país debido a la gran capacidad del lugar. Habrá dos salones donde se realizarán las rondas simultáneamente. Este torneo consta de 10 categorías donde se dará más prioridad a las categorías más populares, teniendo así 4 rondas de 3x3 por primera vez en Argentina. Pedimos a los competidores nuevos que se familiaricen con el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) y se presenten al menos 15 minutos antes del registro y para cualquier categoría en la que participen. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajRqIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5a15438d910a9c0341cea28270f233e50066202/image.png) Welcome to **Buenos Aires Cubea 2022**! This will be a competition focused on gathering competitors from every part of the country due to the large capacity of the venue. There will be two rooms where the rounds will be held simultaneously. This competition consists of 10 events with more priority given to more popular events, thus having 4 rounds of 3x3 for the first time in Argentina. We ask new competitors to familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and to show up at least 15 minutes prior to registration and for any event in which they participate.

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022! ### This year's UK National Championship ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. *Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!* ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion. *Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Open 2022 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic und delegiert von Niko Ronkainen. Diesmal findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Falls Ihr Gäste dabei habt, würden wir euch bei der Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld um die Namen eure Gäste bitten. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Open 2022 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic and delegated by Niko Ronkainen. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. If you bring any guests, please write their names in the comments of your registration.

items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2022 is the last regional championship of 2022 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

items.information: # 🇺🇾 NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 50 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19. Competitor limit: 50. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). * Competitors must provide their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * Read all the information available in this website. Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: 8/21に行われるYoga Summer A 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) と8/28に行われる[Yoga Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerB2022) (以下、B大会) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 **A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (2ラウンド) / ピラミンクス / 3x3x3 目隠し / 4x4x4 目隠し / 5x5x5 目隠し** B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 2x2x2 キューブ / 4x4x4 キューブ / メガミンクス 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。 競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。** また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。 Yoga Summer A 2022 (**This competition, A**) and [Yoga Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerB2022) (B) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these series competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. **A: 3x3x3 Cube (2 round) / Pyraminx / 3x3x3 blindfolded / 4x4x4 blindfolded / 5x5x5 blindfolded** B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 2x2x2 Cube / 4x4x4 Cube / Megaminx The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. **Spectators are only permitted as companions of competitors.** Being mindful of space, we require that **each competitor bring at most 1 guest.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors)

items.name: Pittsburgh Summer A 2022
items.information: This is a series competition with [Pittsburgh Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PittsburghSummerB2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Pittsburgh Summer B 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected. # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, July 30th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, August 9th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

items.name: Abierto del Mirador 2022
items.information: Bienvenidos al Abierto del Mirador 2022, nos complace traerles nuevamente un torneo a la Provincia de Buenos Aires. Nuestro evento contará con 10 categorías oficiales de la WCA distribuidas en 17 rondas. Solo se harán devoluciones del total del pago ($1000) a quienes estén en lista de espera una vez lleno el cupo de 60 competidores siempre y cuando se confirme que no asistirán al torneo antes del mismo, no se harán devoluciones luego del evento. Se aceptarán los registros por orden de llegada del e-mail correspondiente con comprobante a la casilla de correo del organizador. Pedimos que dentro de las posibilidades se atienda al torneo con un (1) acompañante por cuestiones de espacio físico en el lugar del torneo. Pedimos puntualidad a todos y recomendamos llegar al menos 15 minutos antes de cualquier categoría en la que el competidor vaya a participar. Welcome to Abierto del Mirador 2022, we are pleased to bring you again a tournament to the Province of Buenos Aires. Our competition will feature 10 official WCA events distributed in 17 rounds. Refunds of the total payment ($1000) will only be made to those who are on the waiting list once the quota of 60 competitors is filled as long as it is confirmed that they will not attend the tournament beforehand, no refunds will be made after the event. Registrations will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis with proof of receipt to the organizer's e-mail address. We ask to attend, within the possibilities, with a maximum of one (1) companion for reasons of physical space at the tournament site. We ask for punctuality to all and recommend to arrive at least 15 minutes before any category in which the competitor will participate.
